description: The only command-line tool for Zaptec Go chargers â€” pause and resume charging, read live state in plain English, and track energy and cost from a local database.

novel_features.name: Energy & cost rollup
novel_features.description: See total kWh and cost for your charging over any period, rolled up by month or by charger.

novel_features.name: What's-charging-now snapshot
novel_features.description: One table showing every charger's mode (charging/connected/finished/offline) with decoded power, current, and phase.

novel_features.name: Load-balancing headroom
novel_features.description: Show how many amps of the installation's breaker limit are uncommitted versus actively drawn.

novel_features.name: Stale / offline charger watch
novel_features.description: List chargers that are offline, disconnected, or haven't reported within a threshold.

novel_features.name: Firmware drift
novel_features.description: Group an installation's chargers by firmware version and flag the ones behind the fleet majority.

novel_features.name: Session anomaly scan
novel_features.description: Flag charging sessions with near-zero energy, abnormally long duration, or zero cost.
